objects.name: Safety Controller
objects.description: Safety controllers are typically a type of field device used to perform the safety critical function. Safety controllers often support the deployment of custom programs/logic, similar to a PLC, but can also be tailored for sector specific functions/applications. The safety controllers typically utilize redundant hardware and processors to ensure they operate reliably if a component fails.

x_mitre_related_assets.name: Safety Instrumented System (SIS) controller
x_mitre_related_assets.description: SIS controllers are used to “take the process to a safe state when predetermined conditions are violated” (Citation: Guidance - NIST SP800-82) through the reading of sensor data and interaction with digital/physical control surfaces. These devices are oftentimes located on programmable embedded devices running specialized RTOS or other embedded operating systems.

x_mitre_related_assets.name: Emergency Shutdown Systems (ESD) controller
x_mitre_related_assets.description: Emergency Shutdown System controllers are used to read sensor values and interact with control surfaces to return the system “to a safe static condition so that any remedial action can be taken”. (Citation: SIGTTO ESD 2021)

x_mitre_related_assets.name: Burner Management Systems (BMS) controller
x_mitre_related_assets.description: Burner Management System controllers are used to interact with sensors and control surfaces to maintain safe operating conditions for the burner. These can include safely starting-up and managing the main flame, controlling and monitoring the burning conditions, and safely initiating planned or unplanned shutdown sequences.

objects.description_fa: کنترل‌کننده‌های ایمنی معمولاً نوعی دستگاه میدانی هستند که برای انجام عملکرد حیاتی ایمنی استفاده می‌شوند. کنترل‌کننده‌های ایمنی اغلب از استقرار برنامه‌ها/منطق سفارشی، مشابه PLC پشتیبانی می‌کنند، اما می‌توانند برای عملکردها/برنامه‌های خاص بخش نیز طراحی شوند. کنترل‌کننده‌های ایمنی معمولاً از سخت‌افزار و پردازنده‌های اضافی استفاده می‌کنند تا اطمینان حاصل کنند که در صورت خرابی یک جزء، به طور قابل اعتماد کار می‌کنند.
